svg.text: Cerbo GX gathers every Victron device for the GX Touch, Home Assistant and VRM. Hard-wired switches at the rear panel.
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.9.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
LEGEND · line weight ∝ conductor size · ID · size tags = cable schedule IDs · purple ▶◀ = detachable connector · yellow flags = continues on another sheet

svg.text: S1 drives QS1 open/closed; QS1 latches, so S1 position is
the command and the LED confirms the contacts.
S2 open = MultiPlus fully off (inverter and charger).
Modes (on / charger only) are also on the GX Touch.
